newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Dense fog closes Sofia airport.
newsitem.headline: Dense fog closes Sofia airport.

text.p: A dense fog closed down Sofia airport on Sunday, leaving hundreds of passengers stranded as incoming planes were diverted, an airport official said.
"The airport has been closed for two days," said the official.
International airlines flying to Sofia were turning around and Balkan airlines, the national carrier, was landing in the Black Sea port of Bourgas, the official added.
The forecast was for more humid weather likely to cause fog in the next few days.
